# Builds

 In Fallout 76 it is important to use the appropriate perk cards. This allows the full potential of weapons and armor to be used. You can also optimize your carrying capacity, get more XP, and much more. In this category you will find the right guide for many builds and preferences. If you have suggestions for further guides, please write a suggestion under Community > Posts.
